_comment: Task metadata for tools/engineering_loop.py. Deps + impl_model mirror tasks/TODO.md and .ai/MODEL_ROUTER.md. Each task's full code/tests live in the canonical plan (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-17-powerscanner-phase1.md); the loop points Codex there rather than duplicating code. verify = the command the loop runs after Codex to confirm the task is green.

tasks.title: Workspace scaffold + PsError
tasks.objective: Create the cargo workspace (root + core crate) and the shared PsError type.
tasks.commit: feat: workspace scaffold and PsError type
tasks.notes: The plan's root Cargo.toml shows `members = ["core", "gui"]`, but the `gui/` crate does NOT exist yet (it is TASK-014). Listing a missing member makes `cargo test -p powerscanner-core` fail. RESOLUTION: in the root Cargo.toml list ONLY `members = ["core"]` for now, and add a comment `# gui re-added in TASK-014`. Do NOT create a gui/ crate — that is out of scope. Keep the full `[workspace.dependencies]` block from the plan verbatim. TASK-014 re-adds gui to members.
acceptance: cargo test -p powerscanner-core error:: -> tests pass
PsError is a thiserror enum: Io(#[from]), Crypto, Signature, Yara, Config, Tamper; plus PsResult<T>
edition 2021, MSRV 1.74, deps pinned per Global Constraints
core does not depend on any GUI crate; no unwrap/expect outside tests

tasks.title: Machine-derived key (Argon2id)
tasks.objective: Derive a machine-bound key via Argon2id over MachineGuid + volume serial with a per-purpose salt.
acceptance: Argon2id KDF over MachineGuid + volume serial + per-purpose salt (SIG_SALT / RESULT_SALT)
no hardcoded key material anywhere
distinct salts yield independent keys; deterministic on the same machine
tests pass

tasks.title: AES-256-GCM vault
tasks.objective: Authenticated at-rest encrypt/decrypt of file blobs.
acceptance: blob layout [12-byte random nonce][ciphertext+tag]; fresh nonce per encryption
GCM tag failure -> PsError::Crypto, never plaintext fallback
roundtrip + tamper-detection tests pass

tasks.title: HMAC result signer
tasks.objective: HMAC-SHA256 sign/verify with constant-time compare for result lines.
acceptance: HMAC-SHA256 sign + constant-time verify
mismatch -> PsError::Tamper
tests pass

tasks.title: Result types

acceptance: ScanResult/Verdict/Finding serde-serializable
DetectionKind enum present as the fuzzy-hash seam
tests pass

tasks.title: Streaming SHA-256 hasher

acceptance: streams in bounded chunks, never loads whole file
known-vector test passes

live stream while scanning -> filterable table when done; builds clean
